verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a REST API (an OpenAPI spec with 61 paths), a CLI and team-scoped API keys for managing resources. Nothing in the evidence shows usage or billing endpoints, cost breakdowns, or ways to attribute GPU spend by team or workload. A general resource-management API is only an adjacent building block and does not deliver programmatic billing attribution.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
